title: Origins Mutapod
description: The Mutapod Origin from the Lornwood SMP
body:
# The Mutapod Origin 

## The official Origin from the Lornwood SMP now in its Public State

Reminder this Origin is not the same as in the Lornwood SMP this Origin has been cleaned up for public use so some things might be tweaked a bit.

### Origin Info 
For ingame view check the Gallery for a cleaner view 

These creatures are bron unnaturally in the dark of the deepest caves. Skulk binds both humand and giant cave millipede, making a symbiotic pair of fused beings. They are tough, and are built to survive harsh conditions, taking hits most other species cant.

### Subterranean Prowess
Your people have learned to thrive underground, granting you improved vision and movement speed when deep enough inside the earth.

### Defensive Curl
Quickly curl up in your defensive shell to avoid the assult of incoming danger.

### Density
Due to the weight of your body you sink in water quicker than others. Making you extremly prone to drowning

### Heavyweight
Your body is quite a burden to carry with you, causing you to move a bit slower. This weakness is completely negligible once you're deep enough in the earth.

### Myriapod
Due to how your body is shaped its impossible for you to wear normal pants. Actually do you even need pants?

### Noxious Resistance
The Underground exposed you to harmful substances, yet neither the Hunger-bound nor their toxic venom seem to have any effect on you.

### Primordial Root
You appear to have an unusual connection to a strange, unsettling block. While it's not harmless to you, it does toughen your shell when you're on it.

### Silent Steps
The way in which your body glides across the ground creates no sound whatsoever, allowing you to bypass mechanisms, beings and or sensors that rely upon it as a means to detect you.

### Stalwart Disposition
You remain steadfast and unyielding in the face of danger, making it hard for your enemies to move or overpower you.
